svg.title: One prompt through actor claude-alice, step by step
svg.desc: 1 the client app sends the prompt with Alice's JWT to the agent server. 2 the server starts Claude Code. 3 to 5 the model call goes to Warden as the agent itself and on to Anthropic. 6 a tool call goes to the local gateway with no credential. 7 the gateway adds Alice's JWT. 8 the egress gateway adds the actor JWT. 9 Warden adds the GitHub token.
